digest.component_or_area: ticket store / optimistic concurrency / plan-review gate
propositions: A successful description edit was verified by read-back at full character count, then a subsequent read returned an older revision with no error reported, silently losing intermediate changes.
Optimistic concurrency did not reject the conflicting write with a ConcurrencyError/exit 10; instead the write reported success and was silently reverted afterwards.
The ticket was being edited while its own plan-review was running and emitting REVIEW_RESULT sidecar events, correlating with store reconvergence and silent rollback of the newer description.
Whole-description EDIT events with stale client-held text can overwrite newer content via last-writer-wins reduction without compare-and-swap or base revision checking.
A historical reducer-cache race (commit 0b964c82f5) allowed concurrent reducer generations to publish stale state, enabling successful immediate read-back followed by later stale reads.
